integrity: The first divergent profile space is exhausted twice: once over all 7776 labeled five-voter profiles and independently over all 252 anonymous profiles with exact multinomial weights. Kemeny and Slater rankings are each computed by two independent exact implementations.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to exactly three candidates, strict ballots, and odd electorates; the complete census is only for the first divergent electorate size, five voters. The three-candidate structural relation between Kemeny and Slater is treated as prior rather than new.
title: Sharp five-voter divergence boundary for Kemeny and Slater with three candidates
